MESSAGE FROM THE EXECUTIVE CHAIRPERSON Dear valued Shareholders, Building a Stronger, More Diversiﬁed Tirupati Forge One Milestone at a Time It is my privilege to welcome you to the 14th Annual General Meeting of Tirupati Forge Limited. FY26 marks a deﬁning chapter in our Company's journey. Over the past fourteen years, we have steadily built Tirupati Forge into a trusted precision forging company serving customers across automotive, industrial, oil & gas and engineering sectors. During the year under review, we successfully executed one of the most ambitious strategic transformations in our history by entering the defence manufacturing sector while simultaneously delivering record ﬁnancial performance. The commissioning of our defence manufacturing facility, successful operation of our captive solar power plant and the strongest revenue growth in the Company's history demonstrate our ability to translate vision into execution. These investments are not merely additions to our asset base; they represent the foundation of Tirupati Forge's next phase of growth and position us to create sustainable long-term value for all stakeholders. I am immensely proud of our employees, management team and every stakeholder who contributed to this remarkable year. Their dedication, resilience and commitment have strengthened my conﬁdence that the best years of Tirupati Forge are still ahead. Navigating a Dynamic Global Environment FY26 was characterised by signiﬁcant geopolitical and economic developments. The implementation of sweeping tariff measures by theUnited States during April 2025 created uncertainty across global manufacturing supply chains and posed challenges for Indian exporters, particularly companies with meaningful exposure to international markets. “Continuing our legacy of Excellence by expanding Our presence across Global markets” 10 ANNUAL REPORT 2025 - 26

Given that a signiﬁcant exposure to US market, these developments required us to remain agile and responsive. Through disciplined execution, diversiﬁcation of our customer base and an unwavering focus on quality and timely delivery, we successfully navigated these challenges while strengthening our relationships with existing customers. At the same time, India's economy continued to demonstrate remarkable resilience. Strong infrastructure spending, increasing manufacturing activity and sustained investments across sectors such as oil & gas, construction, mining and defence created a favourable operating environment. Government initiatives promoting domestic manufacturing and industrial self-reliance continue to reinforce India's emergence as a global manufacturing hub, creating signiﬁcant opportunities for companies like Tirupati Forge. Delivering Strong Financial Performance FY 2025–26 was our strongest year ever in terms of revenue generation. • Revenue from Operations increased to ₹1,624.79 million, compared with ₹1,149.83 million in FY25, representing growth of 41.3%. • Total Revenue increased to ₹1,659.40 million, compared with ₹1,162.96 million in the previous year. • Net Proﬁt (PAT) stood at ₹62.95 million. • Net Cash Generated from Operating Activities increased signiﬁcantly to ₹160.94 million, compared with ₹58.55 million in FY25, reﬂecting strong operational efﬁciency and disciplined working capital management. • Earnings Per Share stood at ₹0.51. While proﬁtability moderated during the year, this was primarily attributable to higher depreciation and ﬁnance costs associated with the commissioning of our new manufacturing assets. Incremental depreciation and ﬁnance expenses of approximately ₹47.50 million reﬂect investments made for future growth rather than weakening of our core business. The sharp improvement in operating cash ﬂows demonstrates the underlying strength of our operations and provides us with a solid ﬁnancial platform as we begin commercialisation of our new growth initiatives. Defence Manufacturing Transforming Tirupati Forge The successful commissioning of our defence manufacturing facility represents the single most signiﬁcant strategic milestone in the history of Tirupati Forge. ANNUAL REPORT 2025 - 26 11

For the ﬁrst time since the Company's inception, we have established a manufacturing platform that positions us within one of the world's fastestgrowing and strategically important industries. This transition is transformational not only because it opens an entirely new business vertical, but because it fundamentally enhances the quality, proﬁtability and resilience of our earnings proﬁle. Our new state-of-the-art facility has been established for the manufacture of 155 mm artillery shell bodies and is designed to produce approximately 1,50,000 shell bodies annually. The facility has been developed in accordance with stringent international manufacturing standards, including NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs), enabling us to serve both domestic defence requirements and international export markets. During the year, we successfully completed installation and commissioning of the production line, carried out hot trials and manufactured trial shell bodies that met the required technical speciﬁcations. These achievements validate both the engineering capabilities of our team and the technological strength of the facility. The defence sector presents a compelling long-term opportunity. Global geopolitical developments have signiﬁcantly accelerated defence spending across major economies. NATO members continue to replenish strategic ammunition inventories, while several countries are increasing military budgets to strengthen national security capabilities. Independent industry estimates suggest that the global market for artillery shell bodies is expected to grow from approximately US$2.0–2.3 billion in 2026 to US$3.0–3.4 billion by 2030, supported by sustained procurement programmes and increasing global defence expenditure. India is exceptionally well positioned to participate in this opportunity. The Government's continued focus on Atmanirbhar Bharat, increased defence capital expenditure, and strong policy support for defence exports have created an enabling ecosystem for Indian manufacturers. India's defence exports reached record levels during FY25, with an ambitious national objective of expanding exports substantially over the coming years. We believe Tirupati Forge possesses several competitive advantages in this market. 12 ANNUAL REPORT 2025 - 26

Simultaneously, global manufacturers continue to diversify supply chains, creating signiﬁcant opportunities for Indian companies with strong manufacturing capabilities and international quality standards. Tirupati Forge today is signiﬁcantly better positioned than ever before to capitalise on these opportunities through a diversiﬁed product portfolio, expanded manufacturing infrastructure and entry into higher-value sectors. Highlights of FY 2025–26 Our major achievements during the year include: • Revenue from Operations increased by 41.3% to ₹1,624.79 million, the highest in the Company's history. • Net Cash from Operating Activities increased by 175.1% to ₹160.94 million. • Successful commissioning of the Defence Manufacturing Facility for 155 mm artillery shell bodies. • Completion of hot trials and successful production of trial shell bodies meeting required speciﬁcations. • Continuous operation of our 4.8 MW captive solar power plant throughout the year. • Total assets increased to ₹2,037.87 million, reﬂecting strategic investments for future growth. • Successful capital raising through preferential allotments, reﬂecting investor conﬁdence in the Company's long-term strategy. Looking Ahead As we enter FY 2026–27, our priorities are well deﬁned. Our immediate focus will be on commencing commercial production from the defence manufacturing facility, securing long-term customer approvals and expanding our presence in international markets. Alongside this, we remain committed to strengthening our core forging business, improving operational efﬁciencies and enhancing shareholder returns. With the majority of our strategic capital expenditure now completed, we expect future investments to translate into stronger revenues, improved proﬁtability, higher free cash ﬂows and a progressively stronger balance sheet. We ﬁrmly believe that FY27 marks the beginning of a new growth cycle for Tirupati Forge one built on diversiﬁcation, technological capability, operational excellence and long- term value creation. 13 ANNUAL REPORT 2025 - 26

Our decades of expertise in precision forging, advanced metallurgical capabilities, robust quality systems and cost-efﬁcient manufacturing provide us with an excellent foundation for defence manufacturing. Furthermore, India's competitive cost structure, strong engineering talent and integrated steel ecosystem position domestic manufacturers favourably against many global competitors. The defence business is expected to operate at materially higher margins than our traditional forging operations. At optimal capacity utilisation, the facility has the potential to generate EBITDA margins exceeding 40%. Such a business mix has the potential to signiﬁcantly enhance shareholder value by improving proﬁtability, cash generation and return on capital. Our customer engagement programme has progressed well. We continue to engage with domestic procurement agencies as well as international customers across Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Paciﬁc. These discussions are advancing positively as we work towards securing longterm supply arrangements. Commercial production is expected to commence in due course. We expect the defence vertical to become one of the primary drivers of Tirupati Forge's growth. Beyond the ﬁnancial opportunity, our entry into defence manufacturing carries a deeper purpose. Every component we manufacture contributes towards strengthening India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and reducing dependence on imports. We are proud to support the nation's vision of becoming a globally competitive defence manufacturing hub while contributing to national security and technological self-reliance. Sustainability and Operational Excellence Our commitment to sustainable manufacturing continues to remain integral to our long-term strategy. Our 4.8 MW captive solar power plant remained fully operational throughout the year, enabling us to reduce energy costs while signiﬁcantly lowering our carbon footprint. The project strengthens our environmental credentials, enhances operating efﬁciencies and supports our objective of building a globally competitive and environmentally responsible manufacturing business.
